decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the core thermoforming range, so keeping the option open costs little even though there is no recent website evidence.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a standard, cheap-to-carry material with steady lab demand and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
The UV-curing lacquer had only limited web presence, but it supports the firm's digital printing workflows and costs little to keep listed while its uptake resolves.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the strategic move to intraoral scanning, and while scanner improvements may reduce the need for sprays, its carrying cost is low.
Custom earmolds draw on core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so the option stays cheap to hold despite the earlier withdrawal of the related hearing protection line.
